messages:
Amy C.: Quick idea — propose a ramp playbook micro-funnel we can spin up for new signups that ties free credits -> prompt template flow -> 1:1 webinar invite for high-intent users. Goal: 7-day DAU lift and activation rate (first successful completion) + early LTV signal.

Devin R.: Love it. Cohorts? I suggest starting with 'template-tryers' vs 'non-tryers' plus a control. Need power calc for sample size.

Maria L.: For routing, recommend pushing MQL >=60 into a fast lane for the webinar invite. Also need to ensure sales gets qualifying context (prompt used, credit redeemed). cc @Noah P.

Noah P.: Routing feasibility: we can use existing lead tags if we emit a 'credit_claimed' event and a tag 'used_template_pack'. If not, we need a quick instrumentation event.

Sam T.: Tech note — current onboarding nudge lambda only supports a single `template_id`. We'll add `template_group` param and a feature flag. ETA ~3 days for change + tests.

Devin R.: Metrics to track: `prompt_template_use`, `session_3min+`, `task_completed`. Baseline activation ~12% for new signups. We'll aim for +4–6 ppt uplift.

growth-bot: Campaign forecast snapshot — 5k new signups/week -> estimated 250–350 webinar preregs (6% open, 1.5% click to register). Full breakdown: https://go.redwood/ops/campaign-forecast :bar_chart:

Amy C.: Proposal for A/B plan: A) Credits only, B) Credits + template onboarding, C) Credits + template + webinar invite (early-access). Run for 2 weeks or until significance. Keep variants small for easy ops. :mechanical_arm:

Maria L.: Creative plan: 3 template packs (support, sales, ideation). Short microcopy for inbox + in-app nudge. I'll have mock copy + CTA options by Tue.

Noah P.: Quick cohort filter to share with eng: `event:credit_redeemed AND user.prop.signup_age_days <= 7 AND not_in_control_group`. Use that to seed the fast lane.

Sam T.: I'll add `template_group` + `ff.ramp_playbook_v1` flag. I'll post the PR and link to the staging test after it's up. Need QA steps from Product.

Amy C.: Action items (TL;DR):
- Maria: copy + 3 template packs (due Tue)
- Sam: backend change + feature flag (3d)
- Devin: metrics dashboard + sample size calc + segment spec (EOD Thu)
- Noah: routing rule + lead tag mapping (tomorrow)
I'll spin up a Notion page and schedule a 30m sync (Thu AM). Thanks all — small, measurable pilot, then scale if signal looks good. :rocket:
